title: tier-2 shipped code: the scalar mover ramp against MoverRampScalar (0x140ca75f0)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/movement.rs (ramp_scale), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the mover_ramp_scalar entry.
Oracle is MoverRampScalar at exe 0x140ca75f0 (v2b 0x7ff7c59c75f0), a leaf with no .pdata extent; coverageWindow 0x30 stops at the RET at 0x140ca761c.
Read expression: minss(body+0x10ec, 1.0) * scale, where scale is body+0x5b4 when (body[0x10d0] & 2) != 0 and body+0x5a8 otherwise. The scale selection is TEST/CMOVZ, not a branch.
The base ramp fixture keeps the flag byte in a third pointee for the vector unit; this unit's fixture copies it into the body at +0x10d0, which is what the scalar leaf reads.
Call site: FUN_140cc0dc0 reads the scalar as the ramp part of the per-frame input/wish spring.
acknowledgedGaps: The unit proves the leaf's scalar arithmetic and CMOVZ slot. The caller FUN_140cc0dc0 and the wish spring remain open. NaN payload propagation is outside the unit, as in fn/MoverRampVector.
